title: Normal Sinus Rhythm
description: Stable intrinsic rhythm with normal conduction.
objective: Maintain patient stability without unnecessary pacing.
feedback:
1️⃣ Normal Sinus Rhythm
✅ Patient stable — intrinsic rhythm adequate, no pacing needed
⚠️ Unnecessary pacing detected — reduce pacing rate or output
❌ Patient destabilized — pacing interfering with intrinsic rhythm

title: Third-degree AV block
description: Complete AV block with a ventricular escape rhythm.
objective: Stabilize the patient by establishing effective ventricular pacing.
feedback:
2️⃣ Third-degree AV Block
✅ Patient stabilized — effective ventricular pacing established
⚠️ Partial stabilization — check capture or pacing rate
❌ Patient unstable — inadequate ventricular pacing

title: Second-degree AV block (Mobitz II)
description: Intermittent dropped ventricular beats with fixed PR intervals.
objective: Prevent instability by pacing during intermittent conduction failure.
feedback:
3️⃣ Second-degree AV Block (Mobitz II)
✅ Patient stabilized — pacing prevents dropped beats
⚠️ Intermittent instability — pauses still present
❌ Patient unstable — pacing insufficient to prevent pauses

title: Slow Conduction
description: Delayed ventricular conduction with prolonged intervals.
objective: Maintain adequate cardiac output despite delayed ventricular conduction.
feedback:

✅ Patient stabilized — pacing compensates for delayed conduction
⚠️ Suboptimal support — capture inconsistent
❌ Patient unstable — delayed conduction not adequately managed
